newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, shipowners sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, shipowners sidelined.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Wednesday remained steady from Tuesday but enquiries seen weaker, traders said.

They said shipowners were holding back purchases while waiting for prices to ease. A major said he had sold a 180-cst parcel at $127.50 per tonne. Most traders were indicating $126-$128 for 180-cst, $121-$123 for 380-cst.

A trader said prices in Rotterdam have eased to $114-$115 for 380-cst, down from Tuesday's $118-$120. He said this may place downward pressure prices in Asia. MDO and gasoil prices were unchanged at $218-$223 and $233-$238 respectively.
